snippet.title: JUST UNTIL MORNING — Announcement Trailer | Night Shift Horror
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5314630

Rural 17, eleven at night. A gas station in the fog, and the lamps are going out one by one.

JUST UNTIL MORNING is a first-person night-shift horror game. You run a 24-hour gas station alone until seven: serve the customers, stock the shelves, watch four grainy camera feeds — and decide what to do about the things only the cameras can see.

• One full night shift, 23:00 to 07:00, in about 80 minutes
• Four CCTV feeds that see more than you do
• No health bar: the station's lights keep score
• A desk phone that knows where you are standing
• 13 languages

Coming December 2026.

#JustUntilMorning #IndieGame #HorrorGame
